kfae01.title: Overthink every text? Try asking
kfae01.caption:
Drafted the same text forty times?
One honest question beats every draft: ask what they meant.

kfae02.title: Left on read? The Phone Down
kfae02.caption:
Left on read again and staring at the screen?
Put the phone face down. Your night is still yours.

kfae03.title: Scared to double text?
kfae03.caption:
Scared to send the second text?
One kind follow-up is fine. After that, let it be.

kfae04.title: The situationship, solved in a sentence
kfae04.caption:
Dating or just hanging out a lot? Nobody knows.
Ask it plainly and kindly. Any answer helps.

kfae05.title: The 2 a.m. scroll
kfae05.caption:
Still scrolling their profile at 2 a.m.?
Charge the phone across the room. The feeling is smaller by morning.

kfae06.title: Missing your ex at the worst moment
kfae06.caption:
Missing your ex at the fridge at midnight?
Feel it, don't act on it tonight, and call a friend instead.

kfae07.title: Great advice for everyone but you
kfae07.caption:
The friend with perfect advice who never takes it.
Talk to yourself the way you talk to your best friend.

kfae08.title: Single at the holiday dinner
kfae08.caption:
The whole table turns: so, anyone special?
One warm answer, one question back, and you get to eat in peace.

kfae09.title: Your crush said hi. You said yes
kfae09.caption:
Your crush said hi and you answered yes?
Laugh and try again. Awkward twice is still brave.

kfae10.title: Sorry, but...
kfae10.caption:
Can you apologise without adding a but?
A real sorry stops at the full stop.

kfae11.title: Saying I'm fine when you're not
kfae11.caption:
Saying you're fine with a rain cloud over your head?
Not great is allowed out loud. Tell someone safe.

kfae12.title: Checking your compatibility again
kfae12.caption:
Checked your compatibility for the twelfth time tonight?
The chart is a lens. Ask them about their day.

kfae13.title: Planning the date like a project
kfae13.caption:
Made a minute-by-minute plan for a first date?
Leave one hour blank. That's where the good part happens.

kfae14.title: Waiting for them to text first
kfae14.caption:
Waiting three days for them to text first?
Somebody has to go first. It can be you.

kfae15.title: The voice note, take nine
kfae15.caption:
Recorded the same voice note nine times?
Send the first take. The ums are the charming part.

kfae16.title: Everyone's coupled up but you
kfae16.caption:
Everyone's coupled up and you're dodging hearts?
Your timeline isn't late. It's yours.

kfae17.title: Ghosting because no feels mean
kfae17.caption:
Ghosting someone because a no feels mean?
One kind message lets you both move on.

kfae18.title: Someone compliments you and you argue
kfae18.caption:
Someone said they love your jacket and you argued?
Two words: thank you. That's it.

kfae19.title: Waiting for the perfect moment
kfae19.caption:
Waiting for candles and violins to say how you feel?
An ordinary bus stop works. Perfect moments are made.

kfae20.title: We should hang out sometime
kfae20.caption:
We should hang out sometime, said everyone, forever.
Name a day, a time and a place. Thursday works.

kfae21.title: Cancelling plans with yourself
kfae21.caption:
Jumped out of your own bubble bath to say yes?
Plans with yourself count. Keep them.

kfae22.title: They stopped typing. Now what?
kfae22.caption:
The typing dots vanished and so did your calm?
Put the kettle on and call a friend. The reply will come or it won't.

kfae23.title: The Overthinker Bundle (the full infomercial)
kfae23.caption:
Overthinkers, wait for the price on this one.
Four products for the spiral, and every one was already yours.

kfae24.title: The Breakup Recovery Kit (the full infomercial)
kfae24.caption:
Heartbroken? Wait for the free gift.
Space, friends, a morning walk, a journal. And time.
